# The Club by Vighnir

> The Club is a social app for people in India, for iPhone and Android, built
> and run by Vighnir (OPC) Private Limited. People keep a close circle of
> friends (My Club), post photos, Minis (short vertical videos) and Stories,
> message and call each other, join live chat rooms on The Floor, and book paid
> one-to-one online sessions (chat, voice or video) with hosts approved after an
> ID and selfie check. The Club is built and in closed testing in India; it is
> not yet on the App Store or Google Play, and payments are not switched on yet.

## Pages

- [Features](https://www.vighnir.com/features): every feature of the app
- [How it works](https://www.vighnir.com/how-it-works): booking, payment, sessions, refunds
- [For hosts](https://www.vighnir.com/hosts): categories, verification, earnings and the fee
- [Safety and trust](https://www.vighnir.com/safety): date-of-birth check, face check, moderation, reporting
- [Technology](https://www.vighnir.com/technology): architecture, video pipeline, recommendations
- [Business model](https://www.vighnir.com/business-model): a platform fee on paid sessions; no ads
- [About](https://www.vighnir.com/about): the company, the team and the roadmap
- [FAQ](https://www.vighnir.com/faq)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.vighnir.com/privacy), [Terms of Service](https://www.vighnir.com/terms), [Community rules](https://www.vighnir.com/community-rules), [Child safety standards](https://www.vighnir.com/child-safety), [Grievance redressal](https://www.vighnir.com/grievance)
